key_insight: The paper proposes Structure-Driven Inversion (SDI), a new paradigm that solves inverse problems by exploiting problem structure rather than iteratively minimizing an objective.
engineering_relevance: SDI could improve efficiency, interpretability, and parameter decoupling in inverse problems across PDEs, imaging, and physics-informed modeling.
method: Mathematical Structure-Driven Inversion (MSDI): build a spectral-domain pseudo-inverse using unitary diagonalization.
Physical Structure-Driven Inversion (PSDI): use physical structure for virtual-source projection in waveform inversion.
PSDI also includes back-propagation via three structural projections for deep neural networks.
evidence_signal: The abstract is conceptual and taxonomy-focused; it presents representative methods but does not report quantitative experiments or benchmark results.
watch_item: SDI is presented as a framework with representative methods, so practical performance and robustness will depend on how well the required mathematical or physical structure is identified in a given problem.
paper_title: Structure-Driven Inversion: A New Paradigm for Solving Inverse Problems
